description: This file defines the StageInfo class and companion object in Apache Spark, used for storing and constructing information about a Spark stage for scheduling and monitoring purposes.

classes.name: StageInfo
classes.description: Stores information about a Spark stage, including identifiers, status, metrics, and dependencies.

methods.name: stageFailed
methods.description: Marks the stage as failed with a given reason and records the failure time.

methods.name: attemptNumber
methods.description: Returns the attempt number of the stage.

methods.name: getStatusString
methods.description: Returns the current status of the stage as a string ('running', 'succeeded', or 'failed').

methods.name: setShuffleMergerCount
methods.description: Sets the number of shuffle mergers for the stage.

methods.name: setPushBasedShuffleEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables push-based shuffle for the stage.
